title.zh: Playa Phone：把沙漠街角电话亭接入世界
title.en: Playa Phone: Connecting a Desert Phone Booth to the World

excerpt.zh: Burning Man 现场的一座改装电话亭提供限时免费通话，也让陌生人有机会与路过的参与者接通。
excerpt.en: A modified phone booth at Burning Man offers limited free calls and a chance to connect with participants passing by.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 沙漠中的一部公共电话
text.en: A Public Phone in the Desert

text.zh: Playa Phone 是设在内华达州黑石城 Burning Man 活动现场的一座电话亭。该项目位于 3:30 与 Ceiba 街角、飞天意面神教神庙前方，在活动当周剩余时间供路人使用。它把熟悉却日渐少见的公共电话形式，放进了一个高度临时、充满偶遇的场景。
text.en: Playa Phone is a phone booth installed at Burning Man in Black Rock City, Nevada. Located at the corner of 3:30 and Ceiba, in front of the Temple of the Flying Spaghetti Monster, it is available to passersby for the remainder of the event week. The project places the increasingly uncommon form of a public phone into a highly temporary setting built around chance encounters.

text.zh: 知道亲友号码的人，可以通过电话亭免费拨打电话，每次最长五分钟，覆盖范围被描述为世界上几乎任何地方。反过来，外界也可以拨打该号码；如果恰好有路过的人接听，通话便可能成为一次与陌生 Burning Man 参与者的偶然交流。
text.en: People who know a friend’s or loved one’s number can place a free call from the booth for up to five minutes, to what the project describes as almost anywhere in the world. Conversely, people outside the event can call the number, and a passing participant may answer—turning the call into a chance exchange with a stranger at Burning Man.

text.zh: 旧电话亭外形，新通信路径
text.en: An Old Booth Form, a New Calling Path

text.zh: 项目说明称，这是一座普通电话亭，但内部已被改装：它不再收取付款，并通过互联网完成通话。这个设计保留了拿起听筒、拨号和等待回应的实体交互，同时用网络电话连接到电话亭之外的世界。
text.en: The project says it is an ordinary phone booth whose internals have been replaced: it no longer accepts payment and makes calls over the internet. The design retains the physical ritual of lifting a handset, dialing, and waiting for an answer while using internet calling to reach beyond the booth.

text.zh: 使用体验也保留了公共电话的不确定性。电话若正在使用，来电者会听到忙音；若响铃六次后挂断，则表示当时无人接听。项目提醒来电者可能需要多次尝试，这种限制既来自单一电话亭的现实，也构成了偶遇式交流的一部分。
text.en: The experience also retains the uncertainty of a public phone. Callers receive a busy signal when the line is in use; if it rings six times and disconnects, nobody answered at that moment. The project notes that repeated attempts may be necessary, a limitation of a single booth that also becomes part of its encounter-driven character.

text.zh: 网站表示没有广告和追踪器，所收集的数据仅限于其电话账单所需的信息。与此同时，任何接到该号码来电的人都可能是在与朋友、亲人，或临时决定拨号的现场陌生人通话；将号码保存为联系人，可能有助于避免未知号码被静音。该项目在 Hacker News 上获得了显著关注，页面所示讨论为 681 分、217 条评论。
text.en: The site says it has no ads or trackers and that the only data collected is what appears on the operator’s phone bill. At the same time, anyone receiving a call from the number could be speaking with a friend, loved one, or an on-site stranger who decided to dial; saving the number as a contact may help prevent an unknown call from being silenced. The project drew substantial attention on Hacker News, where the supplied listing shows 681 points and 217 comments.
